resources.name: pedestrian-network-flows
resources.title: NYC Pedestrian Network with Estimated Foot-Traffic Flows
resources.description: Citywide pedestrian network (315,577 segments) with estimated pedestrian volumes by trip type and time-of-day, calibrated against 2018-2019 observed foot-traffic counts. Supplementary Data 1 from Sevtsuk, Basu, Liu, Alhassan & Kollar (2025), 'Spatial distribution of foot traffic in New York City and applications for urban planning,' Nature Cities.

sources.title: Spatial distribution of foot traffic in New York City and applications for urban planning — Supplementary Data 1

resources.name: pedestrian-network-flows-metadata
resources.title: NYC Pedestrian Network Field Metadata
resources.description: Field-level metadata describing the columns in pedestrian-network-flows: estimated and observed pedestrian volumes by time period and trip type, calibration flags, and projection info. Supplementary Data 1 Metadata from Sevtsuk et al. (2025), Nature Cities.

sources.title: Spatial distribution of foot traffic in New York City and applications for urban planning — Supplementary Data 1 Metadata

resources.name: elevation-points
resources.title: NYC Planimetric Database: Elevation Points
resources.description: Citywide spot elevation points captured for all building footprint features. Used to derive elevation/grade for the Green-Wood path network. Points fall at building corners, not evenly across open ground, so within the cemetery this will need interpolation or a denser source before it can drive path grade directly.
